title: Component annotation schema + migration checklist for docsite modernization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Our component docs are inconsistent in level of API detail, examples, migration notes and token mapping. This causes repeated reviewer questions, slows onboarding, and makes automated migration scripts brittle. Goal: Define a compact, machine- and human-readable frontmatter/annotation schema for each component (tokens mapping, props/variants, accessibility notes, migration hints), update docsite templates to consume those annotations, and deliver a migration checklist and lightweight tooling guidance so engineers and designers can update components with low friction. Scope: tokens, buttons, tables, charts and the associated utility primitives (spacing, color tokens, typography). Deliverables: 1) Component annotation schema spec (frontmatter fields + allowed values). 2) Migration checklist per component family. 3) Example annotated component docs for Button, DataTable, and ChartLegend. 4) Docsite template snippets and a small lint rule checklist for PRs. 5) Conductor guide for reviewers and the automation owner. Out of scope: changing component APIs or implementing automated code transforms (we will document recommended transforms but not implement them here).
acceptance_criteria: A1: A published annotation schema document exists in Confluence/Drive with examples for tokens, props, variants, accessibility and migration_hints.
A2: Docsite templates accept the annotation frontmatter and render: API table, token mapping, do/don't examples, migration notes and accessibility checklist.
A3: Three component docs (Button, DataTable, ChartLegend) are converted to use the new annotations and linked from the spec.
A4: A migration checklist and PR reviewer checklist is added to the design handbook and referenced in the team's PR template.
A5: At least one eng + one design review approval comment on the spec and the converted examples (recorded in comments).
steps: Draft initial annotation schema: frontmatter keys, types (string enums), and permitted token references.
Prototype docsite template changes to pull fields from frontmatter and render sections (token mapping, do/don't gallery).
Convert Button example doc and validate with accessibility and engineering owners.
Create migration checklist document with step-by-step PR guidance and example commit messages.
Run a lightweight lint pass on 5 existing component docs and record common gaps.
Share spec in design+platform weekly sync for feedback and iterate.
Finalize doc and publish; update PR template and add reviewer checklist to handbook.

notes: Keep frontmatter minimal and future-proof: prefer enum lists and references to central token catalog rather than duplicated values. Aim for machine-parsable but human-friendly wording. Example token mapping should point to canonical token names in the tokens package.
